correctness.rationale: Exact complement-of-interval sign identity M_N(N−k)=E_N A_{N,k} with E_N product of all N flips and A average products of k consecutive flips. For k≤N/2, overlapping k-blocks at cyclic distance d share k−d variables, giving N Var(A)=1+2Σ_{d=1}^{k−1}q^{2d}−(2k−1)q^{2k}→(1+q²)/(1−q²). k=O(logN) independent retained b_N=N^{1/4} blocks separated by k gaps: discarded variance bound O(k²/b_N+b_Nk/N)→0, retained bounded sums satisfy Lindeberg, yielding √N(A−q^k) ⇒ Normal(0,σ²). Conditional on a spaced set J_N of independent signs, parity-weighted characteristic function magnitude ≤(q+|u|k/√N)^{|J_N|}→0, so global parity becomes independent fair sign. Thus √N M(N−k) ⇒ S(a+G) when √Nq^k→a and sharp log-window crossover follows. Reproduced exact mean/variance by full rational disorder enumeration for N=5..9 and all k≤N/2 (16 pairs) at p=1/4. This is not a fixed-time CLT and finite enumeration is not the proof.
